description: This file defines the main React component 'TakeNoteApp' which is the entry point of the client-side application. It integrates various components, hooks, and Redux state selectors to render the note-taking application's UI, handle data loading, synchronization, and user interactions.

methods.name: onDragEnd
methods.description: Handles drag-and-drop actions; swaps category orders if categories are reordered.

methods.name: _loadNotes
methods.description: Dispatches action to load notes from the backend or storage.

methods.name: _loadSettings
methods.description: Dispatches action to load user settings.

methods.name: _swapCategories
methods.description: Dispatches action to swap categories positions.

methods.name: _sync
methods.description: Dispatches sync action with current notes and categories for synchronization.
